subject.title: [F10] openclaw.end_reason always empty on session.ended spans

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `openclaw.end_reason` telemetry attribute, and should it attach to trajectory `session.ended`, diagnostics-otel `openclaw.run`, or both?
rationale: Current main has no such attribute and the documented OTel surface differs from the issue wording, so implementing this safely requires a maintainer-owned telemetry contract choice rather than guessing the public API shape.

options.title: Approve additive shared contract
options.body: Define the enum once, map existing terminal signals into it, and export it on the approved trajectory and OTel surfaces with docs and tests.

options.title: Fold into broader telemetry issue
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102018 as the parent reliability/telemetry contract item and resolve this focused request through that work.

options.title: Decline new attribute
options.body: Keep the existing `status`, `openclaw.outcome`, and `openclaw.errorCategory` fields and clarify the supported telemetry fields in docs.

recommendation.title: Approve additive shared contract
recommendation.body: Define the enum once, map existing terminal signals into it, and export it on the approved trajectory and OTel surfaces with docs and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The central trajectory and diagnostics-otel implementation history in this checkout points to joshavant as the closest routing candidate for the contract decision.
